The '''Crayfish''' is a [[fish]] that can be caught using a [[Crab Pot]] in any [[Crab Pot#Freshwater|freshwater]] body of water. It can also be gifted by a [[Animals#Pets|pet]] turtle with max [[Animals#Friendship|friendship]]. It can also randomly be found at the [[Traveling Cart]] for {{Tprice|75}}.

Like all fish caught from the crab pot, Crayfish cannot be eaten unless it is used in a [[Cooking]] recipe or [[Smoked Fish|smoked]].

==Tailoring==
Crayfish can be used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the [[File:Shirt260.png|24px]] [[Tailoring|Rain Coat]].

==Fish Pond==
Crayfish can be placed in a [[Fish Pond]], where they will reproduce every 2 days. The initial pond capacity is 3 fish, but the capacity can be increased to 10 by completing three quests. Typical output includes light gray Crayfish [[Roe]], [[Green Algae]], and various [[Trash]] items, but more valuable items are possible starting at population 5.

==Quests==
* One Crayfish may be requested by several fish in [[Fish Pond#Quests|Fish Pond quests]].
* Five Crayfish may be requested by [[Giant Stump#Questline|The Raccoon]] as part of the first request or as part of the sixth request and beyond.

==History==
